mobileNotice.title: This step is completed on a computer
mobileNotice.body: Entering your agency's legal identity requires a larger screen. Sign in from a computer to complete it.

pendingNotice.title: Your entry was interrupted
pendingNotice.body: Nothing is lost: every step you confirmed with Continue is already saved in our systems, which remain the source of record. Resume whenever you're ready, you'll find exactly what you already entered.

signataire.title: Who is authorized to sign for the agency?
signataire.subtitle: Provide the identity of the person authorized to commit the agency. We collect this information as part of our compliance controls, under Swiss anti-money laundering law (AMLA).

signaturePower.individualHint: This person can commit the agency alone.
signaturePower.jointHint: This person signs jointly with another authorized person.

agence.title: What is your agency's legal identity?
agence.subtitle: This information must match your commercial register entry exactly. We collect it as part of our compliance controls, under Swiss anti-money laundering law (AMLA).

fields.legalFormPlaceholderNoCountry: Choose the country of registration first
fields.legalNameHint: The official name on your commercial register entry.
fields.tradeNameHint: The name your agency is known by to clients, if different from the registered name. Used to verify your website.
fields.tvaHint: Optional: applies only to VAT-registered entities.

beneficiaires.title: Who are your agency's beneficial owners?
beneficiaires.subtitle: Provide the individuals who own or control the agency. We collect this information as part of our compliance controls, under Swiss anti-money laundering law (AMLA). The reference threshold is 25% (FATF standard): this is a data-entry aid, you can still declare someone below it.
beneficiaires.emptyHint: No beneficial owner declared yet. This is possible if no individual alone owns or controls 25% or more of the agency: in that case, declare the person who controls it another way, or otherwise a member of the senior management body.

fields.ownershipPctHint: Reference threshold (FATF standard): 25% or more. You can enter a lower value.

pep.label: Is this person a politically exposed person (PEP)?
pep.yesHint: Holds or has held a prominent public function, in Switzerland or abroad, or is a close associate of such a person.
pep.noHint: Does not hold any prominent public function.

pieceIdentite.title: Upload the signatory's ID document
pieceIdentite.subtitle: Front and back of a valid ID document (identity card, passport, or residence permit). This document is reviewed by a member of our compliance team; no automated verification is performed at this stage.
pieceIdentite.missingSignataire: The signatory must be entered in the previous step first.
pieceIdentite.formatHint: JPG, PNG, WEBP, or PDF, 8 MB maximum

errors.format: Accepted format: JPG, PNG, WEBP, or PDF.
errors.generic: The upload failed. Please try again.
errors.loadFailed: Failed to load the documents. Please try again.

recap.title: Review your information before submitting
recap.subtitle: Review each section below. You can still edit a step before submitting.

pieceIdentite.loadFailed: Could not check the uploaded documents. Please try again.

recap.attestation: I confirm that the information above is accurate and complete to the best of my knowledge.

errors.legalName: The agency's registered name is missing. Complete the Agency step before submitting.
errors.legalForm: The agency's legal form is missing. Complete the Agency step before submitting.
errors.country: The agency's country of registration is missing. Complete the Agency step before submitting.
errors.signatory: No active signatory is on file. Complete the Signatory step before submitting.
errors.generic: The submission failed. Please try again.

notSubmitted.title: Identity verification not submitted
notSubmitted.bodyAdmin: Complete your agency's identity verification to unlock opening KYC files and sending electronic signatures.
notSubmitted.bodyOther: An administrator or manager of your agency must complete identity verification before a KYC file can be opened or an electronic signature sent.

pendingReview.title: Verification under review
pendingReview.body: The MEGGA team must validate your agency's identity before KYC files and electronic signatures become available. Check back later, the status updates automatically.

rejected.title: Verification rejected
rejected.body: The MEGGA team did not validate your agency's identity. Resubmitting the form will not trigger a new review: contact MEGGA support to learn why and what to do next.

notSubmitted.title: Your agency's identity verification has not been submitted yet
notSubmitted.bodyAdmin: MEGGA verifies every agency's identity before a KYC client file can be opened or an electronic signature sent, as part of our compliance controls, under Swiss anti-money laundering law (AMLA). As an administrator or manager, you can complete this verification now.
notSubmitted.bodyOther: MEGGA verifies every agency's identity before a KYC client file can be opened or an electronic signature sent, as part of our compliance controls, under Swiss anti-money laundering law (AMLA). Only an administrator or manager of your agency can complete this verification.

pendingReview.title: Your agency's verification file is under review
pendingReview.body: Your file has been sent to the MEGGA team. A team member must validate your agency's identity before you can open KYC files or send electronic signatures. Check back on this screen later, the status updates as soon as a decision is made.

rejected.title: Your agency's verification file was rejected
rejected.body: The MEGGA team did not validate your agency's identity. Resubmitting the form will not trigger a new review: contact MEGGA support to understand why and to learn the next steps.
